Zh: 管理你的应用与快捷入口
隐藏主界面的标识、关闭按钮和底部提示，保留应用管理入口
En: Hide branding and hints; keep the carousel and app management.
Changes apply immediately and save automatically.

Zh: 更改立即保存，登录后在托盘运行。
En: Saves immediately. Runs in the tray at sign-in.

Zh: 进入排序模式，拖动头像调整顺序
En: Enter sorting mode, then drag portraits to reorder.

Zh:
拖入一个快捷方式或 EXE，自动添加名称、地址与原图标。
拖入图片可更换当前头像；确认后点击保存。
En:
Drop a shortcut or EXE to import its name, path and icon.
Drop an image to replace the portrait, then save.

Zh:
PNG、JPG、BMP 或 ICO，最大 20 MB。
保存后自动保留图片副本。
En:
PNG, JPG, BMP or ICO, up to 20 MB.
A copy is kept when you save.

Zh: 选择程序、快捷方式或文件
En: Choose an app, shortcut or file

Zh: 本地程序、快捷方式、文件夹，或 https:// 开头的网址。
En: A local app, shortcut, folder, or an https:// website URL.

Zh: ← → 切换    Enter 打开    Esc 隐藏
配色已保存，主界面与管理窗口同步更新。
En: Theme saved and applied to both windows.

Zh: 配色保存失败，保留原主题：
En: Could not save the theme. Previous theme retained:

Zh: 原头像无法读取，可以重新选择图片。
En: The original portrait could not be loaded. Choose another image.

Zh: 已开启：登录后在托盘运行，{0} 呼出。
En: Enabled: runs in the tray at sign-in. Press {0} to show.
Could not restore the startup entry:
Could not apply settings. Configuration unchanged:

Zh: 当前修改尚未保存，是否放弃这些修改？
En: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

Zh:
确定从轮播中删除“{0}”吗？

将移除这个条目的图片、名称、目标地址和参数，不会卸载软件或删除原始图片。
En:
Remove “{0}” from the carousel?

This removes the entry's portrait, name, target and arguments. It will not uninstall the app or delete the original image.

Zh: 当前条目尚未保存的修改也会放弃。
En: Unsaved changes to this entry will also be discarded.

Zh: 已删除，轮播已清空。可以添加新的应用。
En: Deleted. The carousel is empty. You can add an app.
Deleted. The carousel has been updated.
Could not delete the entry. It has been retained:

Zh: 选择要打开的应用或文件
En: Choose an app or file to open

Zh: 应用和快捷方式|*.exe;*.lnk;*.url|所有文件|*.*
已发送打开请求。确认打开正确后，点击保存。
En: Launch requested. Check the result, then save.

Zh: 请先选择一张应用头像。

En: Saved. The carousel has been updated.

Zh: 洁净版已开启，主界面保留轮播和应用管理入口。
En: Clean mode enabled. The carousel and management entry remain visible.

Zh: 已恢复完整界面和操作提示。
En: Full interface and operation hints restored.

Zh: 请从启动器打开管理窗口后设置快捷键。
En: Open app management from the launcher to change the hotkey.

Zh:
鼠标滚轮：切换选中的图标
右键点击任意图标：直接打开对应程序
左键点击图标：选中；再次点击选中图标：打开
点击空白处：隐藏启动器，返回桌面

方向键：切换图标
Enter：打开选中的应用
Esc：隐藏启动器
呼出 / 隐藏快捷键：
En:
Mouse wheel: change selection
Right-click a portrait: open that app
Left-click: select; click again to open
Click a blank area: hide and return to the desktop

Arrow keys: change selection
Enter: open the selected app
Esc: hide the launcher
Show / hide hotkey:

Zh:
可在外观与配色旁输入新组合键并点击“应用快捷键”。

管理窗口：Ctrl+S 保存，Esc 关闭
拖入快捷方式或 EXE：新建应用并读取原图标
拖入图片：更换当前编辑条目的图片

洁净版仅隐藏主界面装饰和提示，操作方式不变。
En:
Enter a new key combination and click “Apply hotkey” in app management.

Management: Ctrl+S to save, Esc to close
Drop a shortcut or EXE: add an app with its original icon
Drop an image: replace the current portrait

Clean mode hides branding and hints; controls remain the same.

Zh: 每次请拖入一个快捷方式、EXE 或图片。
En: Drop one shortcut, EXE or image at a time.

Zh: 图片已替换，点击保存后生效。
已填入目标地址，确认后点击保存。快捷方式按原有设置启动；已有自定义图片会保留。
En: Target filled in. Review and save. Shortcut launch settings and existing custom portraits are preserved.

Zh: 拖动头像到目标位置，松开自动保存；拖到列表上下边缘可滚动。
En: Drag a portrait to reorder; release to save. Hold near the list edge to scroll.

Zh: 顺序保存失败，原顺序未改变：
En: Could not save the order. Original order retained:

Zh: 顺序已保存。当前名称、地址或图片的修改仍需点击保存。
En: Order saved. Save your pending name, target or image changes separately.

Zh: 顺序已保存，可继续拖动，或点击“完成排序”。
En: Order saved. Keep dragging or click “Done”.

Zh: Z-Orbit 已经在运行，请按 Alt + Space 或双击托盘图标。
En: Z-Orbit is already running. Use your global hotkey or double-click its tray icon.

Zh: 无法加载启动器。配置文件未被覆盖。
En: Could not load the launcher. Your configuration has not been overwritten.

Zh: 启动器仍可使用，但开机启动设置未生效：
En: The launcher is available, but the startup setting could not be applied:

Zh:
启动器已经打开，但 {0} 被其他程序或 Windows 占用。

你仍可通过托盘图标打开启动器。
En:
The launcher is open, but {0} is in use by Windows or another app.

You can still open the launcher from its tray icon.

Zh: 点击右下角“应用管理”添加应用
En: Use “Manage apps” below to add an app

Zh:
鼠标滚轮 / ← →：切换    右键图标 / Enter：打开    左键：选中，再次点击打开
点击空白处 / Esc：隐藏并返回桌面    呼出快捷键：{0}
En:
Wheel / ← →: select    Right-click / Enter: open    Left-click: select, click again to open
Blank area / Esc: hide    Show / hide: {0}

Zh: 这个快捷键已被占用，请换一个组合；原快捷键仍然有效。
En: That hotkey is already in use. Choose another combination; your previous hotkey still works.

Zh: 应用快捷方式或程序不存在。
En: The application or shortcut does not exist.
The app configuration is empty. Check:

Zh: 应用列表格式不正确，请检查：
En: The app list has an invalid format. Check:

Zh: 请选择小于 20 MB 的图片。
En: Choose an image smaller than 20 MB.

Zh: 请使用 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 或 Win 组合键。
En: Use a key combination with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.

Zh: 请输入组合键，例如 Alt+Space 或 Ctrl+Alt+L。
En: Enter a key combination, such as Alt+Space or Ctrl+Alt+L.
Could not determine the launcher path.
The dropped file was not found.

Zh: 无法读取原图标，请手动选择图片。
En: Could not read the original icon. Choose an image manually.

Zh: 请选择本地目标，或填写完整的网页地址。
En: Choose a local target or enter a full website URL.

Zh: 网页地址须以 https:// 或 http:// 开头。
En: Website URLs must start with https:// or http://.

Zh: 找不到这个本地目标，请重新选择文件或文件夹。
En: Local target not found. Choose the file or folder again.

Zh: 语言已保存，界面已切换。
语言保存失败，保留原语言：
En: Could not save the language. Previous language retained:
